blast_radius_shape.reasoning: IndexCache has 4 concrete implementations within mimir: InMemoryIndexCache (pkg/storage/tsdb/indexcache/inmemory.go), RemoteIndexCache (pkg/storage/tsdb/indexcache/remote.go), TracingIndexCache (pkg/storage/tsdb/indexcache/tracing.go), and the internal noopCache struct (pkg/storegateway/bucket.go). The noopCache is the trap — it is a private struct inside the storegateway package that implements all 12 IndexCache methods inline, not in the indexcache package. Models almost always miss it because it is in a consumer package rather than the implementation package.
